html: צרה (√ of foll.; cf. Arabic ضَرَا (و, ى) of vein, run blood, bleed, ضَرْوٌ an odorif. tree, or its gum, cf. HomA. und A. i. 4, Sab. צֿרו SabDenkm 83; (Syriac ܨܰܪܘܳܐ fructus pini, etc. is loan-word); NH = BH; as to form cp. Gk. στύραξ (hardly ‖ in meaning, LagM. i. 234, 384, v. Ency. Bib. infr.), cf. LewyFremdw. 41).
